label: Claude with Ponytail
install: set -e; mkdir -p ~/.local; curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.12.0/node-v22.12.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C ~/.local --strip-components=1; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash; claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail; claude plugin install ponytail@ponytail
run: set -e; export PONYTAIL_DEFAULT_MODE=full; c() { claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --permission-mode bypassPermissions ${SWE_MODEL:+--model "$SWE_MODEL"} ${SWE_EFFORT:+--effort "$SWE_EFFORT"} "$@"; }; printf '/ponytail full\n' | c; c --continue < "$SWE_PROMPT"
fired: any(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init" and ((.slash_commands // []) | any(tostring | test("ponytail")))) and (map(select(.type == "result" and (.is_error | not))) | length) >= 2
